model: Contribution per fulfilled ordinary US order before acquisition cost. Not net profit. 34 USD is a price, not a profit; 34 - 13 = 21 is not a profit either.

inputClasses.OBSERVED: Read from the Fourthwall account or catalog. Needs source and date.
inputClasses.PUBLIC_STANDARD: Published standard (URL and date). Not a settled transaction. Needs settledTransaction: false.
inputClasses.PLANNING_ASSUMPTION: Owner decision or scenario. Needs owner and decisionNeeded. Value null means not supplied. Never presented as a fact.
inputClasses.UNKNOWN: value is null and closes says what closes it. Never 0.

rules: Every node with a 'value' has a class: OBSERVED, PUBLIC_STANDARD, PLANNING_ASSUMPTION or UNKNOWN. The calculator rejects unclassified or mis-classified nodes.
null means unknown. It is never 0. A real 0 is allowed only for a non-UNKNOWN class with source and date (or owner for PLANNING_ASSUMPTION).
The ACTUAL contribution takes only OBSERVED values (sellerFundedShippingUsd, supportReserveUsd and discountUsd may also be an owner PLANNING_ASSUMPTION). PUBLIC_STANDARD never feeds it.
The 13 USD catalog base is counted once. 'Catalog flat fee' and 'manufacturing cost' are the same cost; if both fields exist they must be equal and are collapsed into one.
Money is USD with at most two decimals; scripts/economics/contribution.mjs converts to integer cents.

Observed buyer quote lines (shipping, tax, total, delivery window) are valid only for the destination, date and method in observedQuote. They are validated by the calculator and used as the fee base in planningScenario, but never counted as revenue or contribution.
Buyer-collected tax and buyer-paid shipping are pass-through. They are never merchandise revenue and never added to contribution.
planningScenario output is PLANNING_ONLY. It is not profit, not contribution and not paid-acquisition readiness. paidAcquisitionApproved stays false until the owner says otherwise.
